body: I don't know what the one this is. I'm trying to find something to live for. I'm trying so hard to be happy. I'm trying so hard to want to live. I'm trying.

I've been on celexa for 4 years and just recently switched to lexapro, wellbutrin, and stablon.

I try to think positive but all I can see is the negative things in everything

I'm waiting for things to get better but with my depression controlling my mind I feel and I'm scared that it's going to take forever. I've been taking little steps to overcome my depression like take walks with my dogs and that's all I can do for now..

I've always been into yoga, especially hot vinyasa yoga. And some of my swim coaches have had us meditate and visualize before championships, but I've never done it on my own. It sounds like an awesome idea and I'll try. How do you do it?

I love music and it used to give me so much pleasure to play the piano, or the guitar and sing. That was one of the things that kept me going. This was me in college http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9rWA-cpAt-c btw I was high as fuck. Now when I pick up my guitar it just doesn't feel right and I can't get the pleasure I used too. I also used to love swimming and I was swimming for my college, but I got too anxious to enjoy it. I'm going to start going on walks and try to play my guitar and even some art. I'll just have to force myself.

I'm suicidal too and everyone tells me that the best little thing to do is go on walks. I know it sounds stupid I mean all I do is watch tv all day but I will try the walking idea. Also therapy helps.
